jobs.title: SART Program Coordinator RN
jobs.description:
*Job Summary and Responsibilities*

As our SART Program Coordinator RN, you will lead and drive the operations of the Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner (SANE) program serving our Santa Barbara County community. You will set the administrative direction of the program while remaining clinically engaged—participating in the examiner call rotation to care for acute adult, adolescent, and pediatric patients in the Emergency Department. As a central liaison and dedicated patient/victim advocate, you will sustain compassionate, continuous communication with physicians, patients, families, community agencies, and county partners.

Every day, you will deliver comprehensive, trauma-informed acute examinations and precise case management grounded in your scope of licensure and regulatory protocols. You will oversee the meticulous, timely collection and preservation of forensic evidence—maintaining strict chain of custody—for law enforcement and future judicial proceedings, and you will extend your impact beyond the exam room by providing expert witness testimony in court. You will develop and refine program protocols, evaluate outcomes, review SANE charts and evidentiary documentation, and partner with the District Attorney’s SART Coordinator and Santa Barbara County SART Coalition to strengthen coordinated survivor care.

To be successful in this role, you will draw on substantial specialized knowledge, clinical judgment, and advanced skill rooted in the biological, physiological, behavioral, and sociological sciences. You will apply critical thinking to integrate established standards, community resources, and patient data into rapid, accurate care decisions. Your ability to pair clinical expertise with organizational leadership will show up in the way you recruit, onboard, train, and validate the competency of Sexual Assault Nurse Examiners; facilitate quarterly SART education; manage site operations, supplies, and SART billing with the DA’s office; and support annual reporting, grant development, and community prevention efforts.

What You Bring

BSN and active RN licensure, with three years of staff nursing experience
Current BLS
SANE-A and/or SANE-P certification and prior SANE training (preferred)
Bilingual skills (preferred)
Knowledge of rape trauma theory, medico-legal forensic standards, evidence collection, and courtroom testimony protocols

Join us in a role where clinical excellence and advocacy meet—ensuring justice, dignity, and healing for survivors across our community.

*Job Requirements**Required*

Bachelors Of Science in Nursing - BSN
Three years of staff nursing work experience that demonstrates attainment of the requisite job knowledge skills/abilities
Registered Nurse: CA (RN:CA)
Basic Life Support - CPR (BLS-CPR)

*Preferred*

Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner Adult (SANE-A)
Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner Pediatric (SANE-P)

Where You'll Work

Founded in 1940, Dignity Health - Marian Regional Medical Center is a 191-bed, acute care, nonprofit hospital located in Santa Maria, California. Serving over 250,000 patients annually, the hospital offers a full complement of services including Level II Trauma Center, Level III NICU, cancer care, orthopedics, and stroke care. Additionally, Marian Regional Medical Center has been recognized as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality High Performer by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation. It is a Joint Commission-certified Primary Stroke Center, and the only healthcare facility on the Central Coast to offer ECMO.

jobs.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a talented Audit Data Analyst – Staff Auditor for our Charlotte, North Carolina location.

As a dedicated Audit Data Analyst - Staff you will be responsible for working with audit teams to execute audit data analytics. Assists in driving innovation in audit execution by identifying data analytics opportunities, and by developing, deploying & supporting data analysis solutions.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week.
This position will be based at our Charlotte, NC location. Relocation assistance is not
available for this position.

What You'll Do

Executes data analytics approaches in support of internal audits.
Applies data-driven analytic capabilities to identify anomalies, outliers, emerging trends, and operational risks within assigned audits.
Applies analytical approaches to draw conclusions and make 'insight to action' recommendations to answer both audit/business objectives.
Translates recommendation into communication materials to effectively present to colleagues for peer review and senior/lead analysts.
Delivers analysis and findings to mid-level management, garners support for recommendations to assist in driving business decisions.
Assist the team in navigating within diverse environments to locate, validate, extract, and format data for data analysis testing.
Thoroughly documents assumptions, methodology, validation and testing to facilitate peer reviews and compliance requirements.
Builds knowledge in designing data visualizations with more complex tools to support analytical and reporting needs.
Assist and begins to build recurring and continuous reporting and automation solutions in various analytics tools (e.g., SQL or SAS) to support risk identification.

What You Have

Bachelor's degree in Quantitative Analytics, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Data and/or Business Analysis, Data Science, or quantitative field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
1-2 years of data analytical experience to include visualization tools.
Experience applying and working on data and analytics in an audit, risk, or similar controls environment.
SQL or SAS data programming experience.
Ability to understand and/or identify issues from a data perspective.
Experience effectively communicating data to peers and business partners.
Experience working on business reporting or dashboards.
Experience developing operational reporting.
Experience in data processing, database programming, and/or data analytics.
Ability to create data solutions that are efficient, effective, and essential.

What Sets You Apart

US military experience gained through military service or gained as a military spouse / domestic partner.

Compensation range:
The salary range for this position is: $69,920.00 - $133,000 .

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation:
USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Benefits:
At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.

We base salary offers on a variety of considerations, such as education, licensure and certifications, experience, and other business and organizational needs. Applicants must have current work authorization when accepting a UCR staff position. Currently, we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for staff. Detail oriented, with ability to manage time and organize competing priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex information in a clear, concise manner.

In the Heart of Inland Southern California, UC Riverside is located on nearly 1,200 acres near Box Springs Mountain in Southern California; the park-like campus provides convenient access to the vibrant and growing Inland region. UCR's distinguished faculty boasts 2 Nobel Laureates, and 13 members of the National Academies of Science and Medicine.

new_jobs.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a talented Audit Data Analyst – Staff Auditor for our Charlotte, North Carolina location.

As a dedicated Audit Data Analyst - Staff you will be responsible for working with audit teams to execute audit data analytics. Assists in driving innovation in audit execution by identifying data analytics opportunities, and by developing, deploying & supporting data analysis solutions.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week.
This position will be based at our Charlotte, NC location. Relocation assistance is not
available for this position.

What You'll Do

Executes data analytics approaches in support of internal audits.
Applies data-driven analytic capabilities to identify anomalies, outliers, emerging trends, and operational risks within assigned audits.
Applies analytical approaches to draw conclusions and make 'insight to action' recommendations to answer both audit/business objectives.
Translates recommendation into communication materials to effectively present to colleagues for peer review and senior/lead analysts.
Delivers analysis and findings to mid-level management, garners support for recommendations to assist in driving business decisions.
Assist the team in navigating within diverse environments to locate, validate, extract, and format data for data analysis testing.
Thoroughly documents assumptions, methodology, validation and testing to facilitate peer reviews and compliance requirements.
Builds knowledge in designing data visualizations with more complex tools to support analytical and reporting needs.
Assist and begins to build recurring and continuous reporting and automation solutions in various analytics tools (e.g., SQL or SAS) to support risk identification.

What You Have

Bachelor's degree in Quantitative Analytics, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Data and/or Business Analysis, Data Science, or quantitative field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
1-2 years of data analytical experience to include visualization tools.
Experience applying and working on data and analytics in an audit, risk, or similar controls environment.
SQL or SAS data programming experience.
Ability to understand and/or identify issues from a data perspective.
Experience effectively communicating data to peers and business partners.
Experience working on business reporting or dashboards.
Experience developing operational reporting.
Experience in data processing, database programming, and/or data analytics.
Ability to create data solutions that are efficient, effective, and essential.

What Sets You Apart

US military experience gained through military service or gained as a military spouse / domestic partner.

Compensation range:
The salary range for this position is: $69,920.00 - $133,000 .

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation:
USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Benefits:
At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.

The Senior Research Data Analyst will support departments within Research and Economic Development to improve decision making, facilitate continuous improvement of processes and programs, and to maximize impact in the region. We base salary offers on a variety of considerations, such as education, licensure and certifications, experience, and other business and organizational needs. Applicants must have current work authorization when accepting a UCR staff position. Currently, we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for staff.
